Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.services

Class LendingRecordService

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.services.LendingRecordService
@Service public class LendingRecordService extends Object
Service class that handles business logic for lending record operations. Provides methods for managing the lending of games between owners and borrowers.

    • createLendingRecord

      @Transactional public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> createLendingRecord(Date startDate, Date endDate, BorrowRequest request, GameOwner owner)
      Creates a new lending record for a game loan.
      Parameters:
      startDate - the start date of the lending period
      endDate - the end date of the lending period
      request - the associated borrow request
      owner - the game owner
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with success message
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are invalid
      IllegalStateException - if creation fails

    • createLendingRecordFromRequestId

      @Transactional public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> createLendingRecordFromRequestId(Date startDate, Date endDate, int requestId, GameOwner owner)
      Creates a new lending record for a game loan using borrowRequestId. This method provides a convenient way to create lending records from API requests.
      Parameters:
      startDate - the start date of the lending period
      endDate - the end date of the lending period
      requestId - the ID of the associated borrow request
      owner - the game owner
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with success message and the created lending record ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are invalid
      IllegalStateException - if creation fails

    • updateStatus

      @Transactional public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> updateStatus(int id, LendingRecord.LendingStatus newStatus, Integer userId, String reason)
      Updates the status of a lending record with comprehensive validation of state transitions. Prevents invalid transitions and automatically handles overdue detection.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the record to update
      newStatus - The new status to set
      userId - The ID of the user making the change
      reason - The reason for the status change
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with the result of the operation including the updated record ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no record is found with the given ID
      IllegalStateException - if the status transition is not allowed

    • closeLendingRecord

      @Transactional public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> closeLendingRecord(int id, Integer userId, String reason)
      Closes a lending record by setting its status to CLOSED. Performs additional validation before closing the record.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the record to close
      userId - ID of the user closing the record
      reason - Reason for closing the record
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with the result of the operation including the updated record ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no record is found with the given ID
      IllegalStateException - if the record is already closed or cannot be closed

    • closeLendingRecordWithDamageAssessment

      @Transactional public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> closeLendingRecordWithDamageAssessment(int id, boolean isDamaged, String damageNotes, int damageSeverity, Integer userId, String reason)
      Closes a lending record with damage information. Records details about any damage to the game during the borrowing period.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the record to close
      isDamaged - Flag indicating if the game was damaged
      damageNotes - Description of the damage (if any)
      damageSeverity - Severity of the damage (0-3, where 0 is none and 3 is severe)
      userId - ID of the user closing the record
      reason - Additional reason for closing (beyond damage info)
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with the result of the operation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no record is found with the given ID
      IllegalStateException - if the record is already closed or cannot be closed
